name: mlp_heavy
authorization: Ordinary vanilla; replace zero-based blocks 1,3,5,7 attention with independent MLPs; retain original MLPs; remaining attention once. One 10B, monitor every 300s until first finite step. Stop and retire old looping now.

architecture.new_mlp: Independent ReLU squared 512->2048->512; pre-RMSNorm plus residual
architecture.remaining_attention: Full causal, pinned FA3, one pass each
architecture.matched_initialization: Retained weights and caller RNG bitwise identical; new MLP fc original uniform, output zero; fork_rng
architecture.cache: One cache slot per retained attention; final retained attention advances position

training.data: Existing FineWeb-Edu 2K 10B packed cache; dev/test unchanged
training.checkpoint: latest every500 overwrite; best separate; exit85 every1800s; full state resume

validation.profiles: Same GPU baseline/new two orders each20warmup30timed steps; full optimizer; 2K micro16
validation.precision: BF16 activations, original FP32 master weights
validation.logging: Local only, no W&B credentials or returned weights

interpretation: At D512/T2048 major matrix FLOPs almost match, but parameter count increases 7.14%. Existing formal baseline used FLA rather than FA3; no new formal baseline authorized. No claim of equal measured hardware work or isolated quality cause.
